description: This Java class provides a context string (such as 'mysql' or 'postgresql') based on the type of database detected by the DatabaseTypeResolver. It is used within migration scripts to apply database-specific logic.

classes.name: DatabaseAwareMigrationContextProvider
classes.description: A Spring component that resolves the current database type and provides a string identifier for migration purposes.

methods.name: provide
methods.description: Returns a string context ('mysql', 'postgresql') based on the current database type; throws an exception if unsupported.
